QUOTE: With `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off (the default in `mbedtls_config.h:208`)... The "off by default" state of `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` comes from a heuristic on `mbedtls_config.h`, so confirm it against the shipped header.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY as the single build switch and says it is off by default in mbedtls_config.h at line 208. That matches "commented out in the shipped header" in substance, though the answer hedges about it.
